# QYL0500: [Meter] class must be partial static

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.Telemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Error |
| Category | `Metrics` |
| Code fix | Yes |
| Analyzer | `Qyl0500MeterClassMustBePartialStaticAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Classes decorated with [Meter] attribute must be declared as 'partial static' to allow the source generator to implement the metric recording methods. The generator creates static fields for Meter and instrument instances.
